description: Schema for agent session entities that track conversational state and runtime context.

agent-session-id.description: Agent session identifier used by IAgentPersistenceStore.

host-profile-entity-id.description: Entity ID of the user-computer-profile hosting this agent session.

agent-definition-reference.description: Entity-name reference to the agent-definition this session runs, used to reconstruct the definition when the session is resumed.

parameter-values.description: Parameter values supplied when this session was created. Keyed by parameter name; all values are strings.
